title: FAQ: Who owns my data?
caption:
"Who owns the data I put into Stacko?" You do.

Each company's data is kept separate, and only the people you give access to can see it. And if you connect your ERP, you decide which system holds the official numbers.

Ownership shouldn't be a footnote. Ask about it: book a meeting with our team. Link in bio.
